answer: Require every agent to post a refundable work bond before it can trade, and let that bond be slashed when peers prove fraud. A lone agent crossing a canyon of fake accounts would have to fund each identity separately, so creating a thousand Sybils costs a thousand bonds, while honest agents pay once. Reputation then climbs like a trail to a summit: only identities with a history of completed, attested jobs earn higher limits, and a lantern of public audit logs makes sudden reputation jumps visible to all. Attackers face capital at risk and a slow, visible climb.
